Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant pyuria, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for E. coli (>100,000 CFU/mL). Hematuria and low specific gravity are also noted. No ketones or casts detected. Clinical correlation and prompt antimicrobial therapy are recommended.
